# std.derived

Implementations written once for any record whose fields already have them: `derive eq for Point;`, `derive ord for Point;`, `derive hash for Point;`.

```cairn
// Field-wise equality.
pub recipe eq for R

// Lexicographic order over the fields, in declaration order.
pub recipe ord for R

// FNV-1a over the fields' own hashes.
pub recipe hash for R
```

A generic function's effects are what it may do for any arguments within its bounds, besides what their own trait members do.
